published.text: You won't find a wife for the family on this site, lads. Better meet girls the normal way out and about.
Yeah yeah, I know her, we hooked up a few times, but she hasn't replied at all the last three weeks.

Because of this site my daughter hasn't spoken to me for a week. I randomly came across her mate on there and we slept together. Just to be clear - she was already 19, so grand, but seriously watch out, better not like people you know.
Sooner or later everyone ends up on there 😅
I've got a similar story, found a woman on there too, we've been together four months now, kind of an open thing.

My mates, especially the divorced ones, are on there all the time. One of them says she was faithful to her husband her whole life, and now that he left her she wants to catch up on everything she missed and just enjoy life. Honestly I get her.

This is honestly the best site I've ever come across. No pointless chat - match, message, sort it, sleep together and done. Nobody wants anything from anyone, no drama. Thanks to whoever came up with it.
Honestly, I've got a few odd fetishes in bed, and I was properly surprised I found a girl here with the same tastes. Yeah it took a bit, but worth it.
